points.description: States the property: a spanning tree has a single unique path between every pair of nodes (loop-free subnet containing all nodes), so no unnecessary duplicates are forwarded.

Explains the modification: add multicast group membership information to the link state packets, flooded to all nodes, so each node has full topology and group info and can locally compute the multicast spanning tree (e.g. with Prim or Kruskal). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award half (0.25) if only one of the two parts is given: adding group info to LSPs, or computing the tree locally from full topology.
